anchor_rule: An anchor is a derived navigation identity per geocedg/specs/operations/documentation-maintenance.md section 10 (as resolved by GeoCeDGGuideOutline and pinned by PreG9BR5AGuideOutlineTest): a level-1 or level-2 heading takes the id of the "<!-- geocedg-guide-section: <id> -->" marker on the line immediately before it, a level-3 heading takes "<enclosing section id>/<numbering token>" (for example "spline-v2/7.2"), deeper headings and translated heading text never form anchors, and both editions share the same 104 identities.

entries.notes: Only the signature is shown. Missing: the accepted quoted tokens (direction 'forward' | 'reverse'; boundary 'strict' | 'stop-at-end' | 'wrap-to-start'; same-position 'zero-length' | 'full-cycle'); the default of the 3-argument form (forward/strict/zero-length); the semantics (strict leaves an unreachable target absent; stop-at-end returns the incomplete result at the global boundary with targetReached=false; wrap-to-start adds both boundary-side parts without a connector, geometricallyConnected=false; no policy crosses an invalid gap or another component; full-cycle only on one approved periodic component, using the declared fundamental domain and seam); unknown tokens giving an absent or invalid result; Cartesian equality never meaning same-position; that Length takes no policy argument; and any worked example (locus-v2-metrics.md §22, locus-v2-public-surface.md §19).

Named as a document property in three places, but the guide never gives its route (Options → Text font size) or says that changing it marks the document as modified.
The inherited 'Save Settings' item, which saves the current preferences, is not mentioned.
The User tools submenu, Object properties and scripting…, and Legacy laboratory are documented. The 'Algebra Input' show/hide item is not.
The installed tools, the GeoCeDG library, Document tools and the manager are documented.
The submenu for macros embedded in the open document is documented, including its precedence rules.
The bundled library is documented as a whole; per-tool purposes are missing (see the tool:ggt-library entries).
About, User guide and Current tool help are documented. Input help (as an item), Command list and Keyboard shortcuts are not.

The guide says 'context menu', but the product adds a 'GeoCeDG' submenu to the decorated object context menu. It holds Animate selected object, Inspect rich result, Create selected intersection point, Standard view, Show all objects, Object properties and scripting…, Current tool help and Inspect definition…. The submenu is not named, and the Graphics View right-click chooser is undecorated.
Placement and enablement rules are documented.
The inherited context-menu items (show object or label, trace, rename, delete, object properties, …) are not described.
The clickable segments and notices are documented.
Only the numeric line-thickness field is documented; the rest of the inherited style bar is not.
The guide calls it 'Move'; toolbar flyouts have no visible group label. The members (Move, Move around Point, Working Layer) appear in 12.5 with the wrong name 'Rotate around Point'.
Called 'List tools', just right of Move.
Called 'Point and Intersection'. The members (Point, Point on Object, Midpoint or Center, Attach / Detach Point, Intersect) are not listed; Attach / Detach Point is undocumented.
Called 'Lines and vectors'.
Called 'Polygons'.
Called 'Derived constructions'. The guide does not say that this flyout also holds Angle with Given Size and Tangents.
Called 'Circles and conics' (seven primary tools; the rest are menu-only).
The behaviour of this profile flyout (it remembers the last action) is documented.
Called 'Angles and lengths'; Area and Slope are menu-only.
Called 'Transformations'.
Called 'Parameters and drivers'; includes Text.

12.4 says 'The same actions are on the toolbar in the Navigation flyout', but the flyout holds only Move Graphics View, Zoom to rectangle, Zoom In, Zoom Out and Copy Visual Style. Zoom Factor In/Out, Standard view and Show all objects are menu-only.
The native format, what it preserves and its backward-compatibility rules are documented.
Opening is documented. See action:document.save-as for the undocumented refusal to save as .ggb.
Listed as accepted types, but the guide does not explain what opening a .ggt package or an .html/.htm worksheet does.
The refusal message and the unchanged state are documented.
The menu route is wrong; see action:export.picture.
The exact page size, Export Text as Shapes, physical line widths and size limits are documented.
The exact viewBox and the five-significant-digit path limit are documented.
Device-unit rounding and the physical frame are documented.
It shows the same area as the export and omits hidden layers.
The presets, free a:b entry, session scope and status-bar display are documented.

entries.label_en: Hidden layers (Algebra view, Sort by Layer, eye)
entries.notes: Hiding, saving, the undo exclusion, error handling and export effects are documented.
The guide says that --export uses the same area and that --exportAnimation is refused, but it gives no syntax or example (arguments, accepted formats, scale or dpi).
The export-area semantics are documented; the function signatures are inherited and not documented.

entries.label_en: STL, Collada, HTML Collada, Dynamic Worksheet/upload, Animated GIF, WebM
entries.notes: Deliberately not offered: the profile's file-import-export group exposes only five exporters, and animated exports are refused (PictureExportCommandLine). The guide states the exclusion.
The paste semantics (unit notice, kept layers) are documented, but not how to copy or paste: the Edit menu has no Copy or Paste items, and the keys are missing from 16.4.
The guide refers to new windows and to several open windows, but never says how to open one (Ctrl+N; there is no File menu item).

entries.label_en: Title blocks, sheet sets, broad CAD import
entries.notes: Profile deferred_inventory document.sheet-export: title blocks are deferred to G15 and broad CAD import is out of scope. The guide states that title blocks and DXF import are unavailable.
